summary: For each non-background color, take the bbox height of its cells (max_row - min_row + 1); sort colors by height descending; output a (max_height) x N bar chart whose column c is a vertical bar of height_c cells of color_c at the top, 0 below. Input structure: 0-background grid with 2-5 colors, each color owning a contiguous row band (one contiguous run per row); later rectangles carve earlier ones from the edges, but every color keeps cells in its band's top and bottom rows, so measured height == band height; band heights are distinct.
